༄༅// dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang drin bla na med pa'i shing rtar brten// bcu gsum rdo rje'i grong yang skye ba 'dir// bgrod la dka' ba med par rgyal kun gyis// bsngags pa'i yul gyur rdo rje slob dpon rgyal// dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bgrod gcig lam// zab mo rdo rje theg par skal ba can// smin byed dbang gi snye ma bsu ba'i slad// mtshams sbyor dbyar gyi rnga gsang rnam par dgod// yid 'phrog gzhan gyis gsos pa rgyas pa'i glu// thos pa 'dzin pa'i zil mngar lhur len pa// phrad dka'i rdo rje theg par 'jug pa'i sgo// 'chad 'di mnyan 'os nyid du bstan pa mtshon// 'dir dpal sam+pu ṭa'i rgyud kyis legs par bstan pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar cho ga dag par byas nas/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga yang de nyid nas 'byung ba'i slob ma sta gon dang slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ltar dang*/ de'i mtshams sbyor spyi'i bshad pa phal cher kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang bshad lung rigs man ngag gi snying po blor nges par byas nas/ khyad par 'byin 'jug dgos pa rnams 'dir brjod pa la/ slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i phan 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs te/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/

chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa rnams kyang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la thog mar 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang mgon po byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tsha la sogs reg skyed bzhin zhes gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ dmyal ba pa la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal zhes sogs nas/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin te/ dper na 'bras dkar mo lo legs na rtswa dang phub ma zhar las 'byung ba dang 'dra ba yin/ 'og tu nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed pa med pas 'di ma chad pa gal che'o// de lta bu'i blo can rnams kyis gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par theg pa che chung gi dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces gsungs pa ltar theg pa chung ngu las khyad chos bdun gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa theg pa chen po yin/ de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las kyang*/ khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde'i dbye sgo mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa las/ 'dir rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor gong ma de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang ting nge 'dzin mnyam par ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ nang ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med par ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir drang ba'i don du shes rab zab mo'i don gtso che zhing*/ nges pa'i don du thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin/ rgyud sde 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi gleng gzhi'am/ rtsa ba bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sam+pu ṭa nas legs par bstan pa'i rdo rje dbyings lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor chen por mngon par dbang bskur bar bgyi/ de la spyir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon sogs spro na spyi ltar brjod/ dbang de ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba gnyis las skabs gang bab brjod/ dang po ltar na gsum pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga yin zhes sam/ phyi ma ltar na nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/

de la'ang*/ lus kyi bya ba gsol ba gdab// spro ba bskyed cing bsrung ba bya// rgyun bshags byas te srung skud btags// so shing ku sha khyor chu sbyin// mchod cing chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar chos bcu gnyis yod pa las/ lus kyi bya ba ni/ khrus byas gtsang zhing gos dkar gyon// yo byad rnam pa kun dang ldan// byams pa'i sems ni nye bzhag nas// dkyil 'khor drung du nye bar 'dong*// zhes pa ltar khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas slob dpon la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod ces 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyad par can gyi don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa stsal du gsol snyam pas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi// zhes sogs nas gzhug tu gsol zhes pas gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don srid pa ni rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang zad du med pa/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa sdug bsngal mi bzad pa chu srin chen po la sogs pa lta bu 'jigs pa du ma dang bcas pa'i gnas de las/ bde ba'i skam sar 'don par mdzad pa'i slob dpon de la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/

de'i rten du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /de ltar khyed rnams kyis gsol ba gdab bya'i snying po khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu tshur sogs nas 'di gyis shig ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni khyed rnams la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos nas/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ de la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang 'jig rten pa rnams drang pa'i don du slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin pas kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces bya ba tha tshig go /de nas bsrung ba bya ba ni/ de ltar spro ba skyes pa'i slob ma la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched du slob dpon gyis/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs gtso bo'i sngags brjod pa dang*/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas khyed rang rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma dang thod pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang sogs nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gyis gtso bor bskyed la/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du mas yar reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ mgrin par pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ spyi bor nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rnams lam gyis byung bar mos shing*/ slar yang yas mar reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyag mtshan de rnams yig 'bru gsum gyis so sor mtshan par gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'di'i sgo nas ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar 'gyur ba yin no// rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ de ltar bsrung ba byas pa'i slob ma de/ dbang gi snod rung du bsgrub pa la rgyud dag par bya dgos te/ spyi rgyud las/ dang por gsum la skyabs song ste// de nas bla mas byang chub sems// ma skyes pa rnams bskyed bya zhing*// skyes pa slar yang dran du gzhug /ces gsungs pas na/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos nas/

de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par bgyi snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa thams cad la sems can gyi don phyir mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs snyam pa dang*/ sgo gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bsod nams thams cad sems can gyi don du bla na med par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ gzhan don bla na med pa bsgrub pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed cing de'i spyod pa rnams la'ang tshul bzhin bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa ste don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag gis thog ma med dus zhes pa nas/ gnas par bgyi zhes pas rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing*/ thob pa yar 'phel du byed la nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin no// rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir srung skud 'dogs pa ni/ spyi rgyud las/ bu mo gzhon nus bkal pa'i skud// blangs nas bzhi bcu rtsa dgur bzla// slob ma rnams ni blos bsam ste// mnyam par bzhag pas mdud pa bor// zhes pa ltar gyi srad bu la hūm̐ bzla zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab par/

gtso bo'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa/ sum bsgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la mdun bskyed ces bsgyur/ gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig pa'i srad bu la thim zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid gtso bo'i snying po dang las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla bzhin pas/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par nyis bskor du bcings la las bum gyi chus gtor zhing*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas brtan par bya'o// dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa la thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ so shing u dum+bā ra'am/ a shot+tha ni rma med pa// ha cang mi sbom mi phra zhing*// sor gangs bcu gnyis tshad du bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i so shing gong ltar bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du byin te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs gtso bo'i sngags kyis byin/ de ltar byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te so drud pa zhig byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de/

khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing thal mo kha phye ste so shing gi rwa ba tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su ltos pa med par dor cig ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dri'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhi par tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du dor bcug de ltar dor bas rtse mo bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog 'grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ shar du zhi ba/ ltor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ rin chen 'bar bar/ ku sha snying po rtse ma nyams// dhīḥlas byung bar bsam par bya// zhes gsungs pas ku sha bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ dhīḥbazlas pas ku sha chung ba sngas kyi phyir phyag g.yas dang*/ ha bzlas pas che ba stan gyi phyir phyag g.yon par byin par mos zhes pas byin no// de'ang sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin du 'dir yang ku sha'i stan la nyal te rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa yin no// rmi lam gsal po 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ ji skad du/ gsang sngags dag gis spos kyi chu// khyor bar blugs la lan gsum sbyin// zhes gsungs pas na/ dri zhim po'i chu la/

a hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas pa'i khyor bar lan gsum re byin pa de nyid ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed du bsams la btung bar bya'o// khyed rnams byang chub tu sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du bdug spos shangs la dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don du shes par byas nas chos zab mo bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum+bā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas dkon te/ sangs rgyas gcig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum+bā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung*/ de'ang sangs rgyas de rgyal rigs las 'byung na me tog de dkar po dang*/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bu/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa na bskams nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsung ba dkon/ chos kyi nang nas theg pa chen po gsung ba dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba shin tu dkon/

dkon pas ci phan ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na/ de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bye ba zhes sogs nas dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par mdzod cig ces bya ba'i tha tshig ste 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ rmi lam gyi mtshan ltas brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /ces sogs nas rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ spyi rgyud las/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni// yon tan rgya mtsho sogs nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no zhes pa'i bar kye rdor ltar las/ thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ bong bu la zhon te lho phyogs su song ste ma log pa dang*/ spre'u la zhon nas shar lho dang shar phyogs su 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo zhes pa tsam dang bden med kyi snang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsrungs la/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor sogs dang sbrel/ gzhan 'dra'o// de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags zhes brjod do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs nas/ 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag pa'i slad du zhes pa'i bar kye rdo rje dang 'dra bar brjod la/ ji skad du/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa// zhes bya ba'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i bde ba chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa re bskyed mdzod/

de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ rjes kyi cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po la bdag bskyed sngon du song bas/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa ste rnam pa bzhis bsgrubs nas/ nang du dkyil 'khor pa mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ phyi rol du zhing skyong 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim par bya ba/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad yin na bum pa sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams dgos te/ kho bos sngon nas legs par grub zin pa yin/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis las/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang thams cad bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa ste/ de dag kyang sngon du legs par grub cing*/ de'i rjes su phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang zhing*/ de kho na nyid dang bden pa bsgrags pa rnams grub par byas zin/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab gnyis// dris lan sdom pa bsgrags gzung bya// gos dag byin la gtsug tor bcing*// mig dar 'khyil pa me tog gtad// sgo gsum byin rlabs dris lan gnyis// nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// dkyil 'khor nang bcug lus phul nas// dam tshig spyir sbyin dam gzhag bzhi// maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab ye shes dbab// brtan byas lha la gsol ba gdab// me tog dor bcing gdong g.yogs bkrol// dkyil 'khor bltar bskul phyag byar gzhug

/lha ngo bstan pa 'jug pa'o// zhes pa ltar las thog mar slob dpon la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod ces 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen sogs nas bdag la stsol/ zhes pas slob dpon la gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rnams dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu ba ni/ las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba cung zad bteg slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du langs te/ rnam dag slob ma 'di rnams ni zhes sogs nas 'tshal/ zhes pa'i don ni thun mong ba'i sbyang bas rgyud rnam par dag pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin 'dzin cing gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams nod par 'tshal na/ de bzhin du gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba'i don to// de nas gsang ba'i dam tshig 'dzin pa la spro'am zhes dri ba ni/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs sogs nas 'dod dam zhes pa'i don ni/ gsang ba chen po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rigs te/ rgyud rnam par dag pa gsang ba'i ngo bo dam tshig dang sdom pa yongs su 'dzin par bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam zhes bya ba yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang ji ltar dris pa de ltar 'dzin par spro'o zhes lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyi mthar/ sems dpa' chen po bdag 'tshal lo// zhes lan btab nas/ gzung bar bya ba'i dam tshig thob par byed pa la khas blangs dang cho ga gnyis las khas blangs kyi sgo nas thob par byed pa la gzung bya'i dam tshig ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir sdom pa bsgrags pa zhes bya ba 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// zhes sogs nas/ gsang ba'i rgyud la rab tu bsgrags// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi dam tshig tu dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa sogs kye rdor ltar bsgrags/ de ltar bshad pa'i don de dag yid la dran pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar zhes sogs kyi brda sprod gong sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas la/ bdag gis thog ma med dus zhes sogs nas gnas par bgyi zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// zhes sogs nas dgod ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa gzung bar khas blangs nas gzung bya dam tshig dang sdom pa thob byed kyi gtso bo ni dbang bskur ba las thob par 'gyur zhing*/ dbang bskur ba ni dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chas su gzhug pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas te smad g.yogs dmar po re thogs nas khyed rnams la byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ slar yang stod g.yogs re yang byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ zhes dang*/ yang spyi bor gtsug tor re yang bcing bar mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas/ sngon chad rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong bcing bar mos/ oṃ tsak+ṣu zhes pa nas hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas/ slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chus gtor nas bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe sogs brjod/ zhes pas bsrungs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas/

phyag rten gyi slad du me tog rigs lnga brgyus pa'i phreng ba re yang byin par mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis byin nas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po rnams gsal btab nas/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams sbyangs par mos nas/ slob dpon gyis yi ge gsum brjod cing khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i phyag rgyas reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sam/ yang na hūm̐ brjod cing 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum lte ba gsang gnas rnams su reg ste byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod ces dang hūm̐ bzla'o// de nas rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// 'dun pa nges par bya ba'i slad du/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig 'dod pa des gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sems can thams cad la phan pa bla na med pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed de/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam du yid la byas te/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal lam gyis byung bar mos te/

de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs brjod/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra sogs nas/ ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas sems bskyed pa rnams phyi 'jug gi gtso bo yin pas brda don 'phrod pa gal che/ sems bskyed pa de dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyi kun du spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du smrar mi btub bo zhes gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod zhes pa nas la'ang ma yin no zhes gsang bar gdams pa rnams ni phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi lag pa nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ki li zhes pa nas yuṃ swā hā/ zhes pas zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nang mjug gi chos gsum las thog mar lus dbul ba'i slad du/ khyed rnams skad cig gis sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo zhes pa nas nyi ma la hūm̐ rnams gsal btab/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la gus pas lus 'di dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pas phyag thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun du zhes pa nas dbul bar bgyi/ de ltar lus phul nas/ ye shes dbab pa dang 'brel par dam tshig spyir sbyin pa dang dam la bzhag pa bzhi las/ thog mar dam tshig spyir sbyin pa'i slad du/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po re gsal lam gyis gyur par mos pa mdzod/

de nyid brtan pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag cing dril bu 'khrol ba dang bcas te/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes dang*/ khyed rnams kyis sa ma ya a haṃ zhes gsungs shig ces pas brtan par byas nas/ dam la bzhag pa las/ dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod ces pa nas gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa nas gshegs zhes dang*/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dung chos su blugs pa sbyin te/ 'di ni zhes pa nas ṭhaḥzhes dang*/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ de ring phan chad zhes pa nas 'gyur/ zhes pa de rnams sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa yin/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams lus tsog pu gang la'ang ma snyes par me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te sems gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma ltar shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas khyed rnams kyi rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung sogs nas dkyil 'khor la has mtshan pa rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyod pa zhes pa nas/ dang po'i rdo rje'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas byon te khyed rang rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas dpag tu med par zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ āḥzhes pa nas ha dzhaiṃ/

zhes 'bebs sngags mang du brjod cing rol mo bya/ de ltar ye shes bab pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sogs nas/ srol bar gyis shig de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i ched du khyed rnams mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas te mig gi lam du kha dog gang snang ba zhig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am sna tshogs sam khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtags nas lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i slad du/ dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs pa slob dpon gyis bgyi zhes brjod cing langs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas de bzhin shog ces gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba ni sngar gyi me tog phreng ba phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi sgo gsum du yi ge gsum gsal ba las spros pa'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang gsal zhing sdig pa rnams bkrus par mos pa mdzad de/ me tog gang la 'bul ba'i yul ni 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su dag pa gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ ngo bo la mchog dman gyi khyad par med mod/ rang gi las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog shig snyam pa'i blos/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes gsung zhing 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod cig ces bsgos la dngos grub mchog 'bring dman pa gang 'grub pa nges par byas la/

me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ pra ti zhes pa nas gzung bar bya/ zhes pa ni me tog phreng ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas khyed rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐/ dpral bar ram̐/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ re bsgom mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa nas āḥswā hā zhes ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig ras lhan cig bsal te/ spro ba bskyed cing dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor 'di la zhes pa nas brlab/ ces pa ni dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba yin pas dkyil 'khor legs par gzigs shig dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo sprad pa 'og tu 'byung ba 'dir yar blangs te bstan pa ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje'i rwa ba gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad sogs nas brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa sum rim zhes pa nas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang pa'i steng 'og thams cad shar dkar zhes pa nas nyi ma'i gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma sngo bsangs/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu ste/ sgo ba bzhi ka'ang zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ dbang ldan du me tog ma dkar mo/ mer bdug spos ma dud kha/ bden bral du mar me ma ser mo/ rlung du dri chab ma dmar mo/

dkyil 'khor bar ma'i dbang ldan du gling bu ma dkar mo/ mer pi wang ma ser mo/ bden bral du mu kun+da dmar mo/ rlung du rdza rnga ma ljang gu ste/ phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lha snam gyi shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa sku mdog ser po/ g.yon du sa snying dkar po/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje nag po/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po ser po/ nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ g.yon du 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po dkar po ste/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor dang po'i lha snam gyi shar du rdo rje drag shul ma dkar mo/ lhor rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma ser mo/ nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang gu/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser/ mer rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser/ bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ rlung du sa rdo rje ma ljang skya ste lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dbus kyi le tse dgu'i shar gyi re mig gi gdan la rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhi ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu ste de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dbang ldan du sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ mer mā ma kī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis ma/ bden bral du gos dkar mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ rlung du sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma ste lha sum cu rtsa drug gis bskor ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa sku dang rtsa zhal zla ba ltar dkar zhing chu shel dwangs pa nor bu rin po che ltar 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/

rang 'dra'i shes rab ma dang bcas pa ste zhes pa lta bu rags pa tsam brjod pas sam yang na ming tsam brjod pas lha ngo bstan la/ de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang yang rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' ba'i blos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos nas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs ho ho ho zhes pas phyag bya ba rnams ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab// dbang stegs lhar bskyed chu bzhi dang*// sdig pa sbyong ba nyer spyod lnga// bkra shis rigs pa'i dbang lnga dang*// brtul zhugs bzlas lung thun mong dbang*// zhes pa ltar las rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nas thob par mdzod/ ces pas gsol ba btab nas/ shis par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod/ mdun du bzed zhal gyi snod gnyis/ mes bkang ba'i kham phor/ sbyang chas rnams bsham/ til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis bya/ de nyid la chu bzhi'i sbyang ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ni ri sogs nas/ ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas sbyangs nas/ khyed rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs nas mdun gyi yungs kar la thim/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas thugs rdo rje zhig bye ba las kyi rdo rje dang tha mi dad par gyur nas/ khyed rnams kyi sdig sgrib kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yungs kar de g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs/ g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar mos pa mdzod/

oṃ sarba zhes pa nas hā/ slar chus kyang sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ nas phaṭa ces pas byur bsal nas/ bkra shis kyi cho ga bya ba la thog mar khyed rang rnams mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa thogs nas g.yas su yo ba dang bcas te bkra shis kyi cho ga byas par mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la 'di ltar nges par bya ste sogs nas/ phyag len phal cher 'di la mdzad pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ shū n+ya nas haṃ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ gsum ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po nas bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥslob dpon la thim/ de dag gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas thugs rdo rje ma/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga zhes pa nas sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ de dag la slob dpon gyis/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa ni bdag 'jug gi skabs su brjod pa yin gyi 'dir dkyus ltar 'don no// oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing slob dpon dang dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ khyed rnams la sgrub chen bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi dbang gi lha rnams la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs zhes pas mchod cing*/ slar yang*/ he ru ka dpal nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin nas stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rigs lnga po he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin can gyi bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs te/ slob dpon dang lhan cig pas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ sgo ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te khyed rang rnams mi bskyod par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas lha so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu/ badz+rī bha wa a bhi badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes pa'ang byung ṣīñtsha hūm̐ btags zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dang*/

chu'i lhag mar yar lud pa las khyed rnams kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sogs nas bzhag pa yin no// 'og ma rnams la slob dpon lhar bskyed pa dang dbang lha spyan drang ba dor nas lha dang dbang rdzas go bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga'i 'gros 'di nyid sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te sogs nas sbyor ba/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa de la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ de'i mig tu nas thugs rdo rje ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan sogs nas cod paṇa du gyur/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sogs nas stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin can gyi cod paṇa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs nas khyed rnams rin chen 'byung ldan du gsal ba'i spyi bor bcings te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rin po che'i nas māṃ/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ buṃ aṃ sogs sa bon sum cu so bdun tsam gyi mthar oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/

de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod de/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nas bzhag pa yin no// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa sogs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos bar gyi lha dang dbang rdzas kyi khyad par ma gtogs gong gi rigs 'gre/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te khyed rnams 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas su byin nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sogs nas bzhag pa yin no// don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi slad du nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs sogs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos bar 'gre/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dril bu gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te/ khyed rnams don yod grub par gsal ba'i phyag g.yon du byin nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sogs nas bzhag pa yin no// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du sogs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhyed rang rnams la thim/ 'dir dbang rdzas lhar bsgrub pa med pas khyed rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje nas thugs rdo rje ma/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sogs nas gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam snang gi rang bzhin can gyi ming gdan gsum tshang ba re me tog gang la phog pa'i lha las dras te btags par mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa sogs nas ṣe ka ta kye zhes dri/ gsang mtshan med na gsar du gdags te/ de'ang skyes pa la rigs dang mthun pa'i ming dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ bud med la/ rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje mtshon cha ma// rdo rje bdag med e ma ho bde ma// rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs gang rigs gdags// de nyid brtan pa'i slad du chu dbang sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ dngos kun sogs nas blta bar bya/ zhes gsungs te/ de'ang dngos po ste chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba ni/ gtso bo ste rang gi lhag pa'i lha yin la/ lha de yang glo bur du byas pa ma yin gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i phyir gdod ma nas lhar rnam par dag cing glo bur gyi dri ma rnams cho ga 'dis sel bar byed pas na/ da phyin chad de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su blta bar bya'o zhes pa'i don yin/ de dag gis ni ma rig la sogs pa'i nyon mongs lnga rig pa ye shes lngar bsgyur bar byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngam/ rig ma spyan la sogs pa'i thabs rig pa yab lnga'i las yin pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ba yin/ de rnams kyis chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs nas/ de dag gi chos nyid drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' ngo sprad de sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te sogs nas bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhyed rang rnams la thim/ de'i mig tu nas thugs rdo rje ma/ slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nyid la rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang sbyin pa'i slad du/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas/ dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang gser sogs las grub pa'i rdo rje sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de ltar rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin can du gyur pa de khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas par brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de nas hūm̐ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de gsor te snying gar bzung nas/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la zhugs par gyis shig de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas bya spyod kyi chu cod paṇa rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang lnga las thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud 'chad pa dang nyan pa la dbang ba'i dbang thob/ de'i steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum brtul nas rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang thob nas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob ma'i dbang las thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i bla med kyi rdo rje slob ma'i dbang thob pas rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang bar byas shing*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'chad pa la mi dbang yang nyan pa la dbang ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs dang dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// de bas na khyed rnams me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsgom bzlas la brtson par gyis shig bzlas pas sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur bas khyed rnams kyis dman pa dang 'bring gi dngos grub gang 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar nges par byas nas sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

sngags kyi dbang bskur sogs nas stsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'od zer dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas sngags rnams la dbang thob par bsams la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsum mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra phyag len la gtso bo'i sngags tsam las mi mdzad/ sogs kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de nas slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis nas mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog spyi bor bzhag la sngags kyi dngos grub stsal zhing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la nas gsol/ des sngags kyi bzlas lung thob nas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ phyag rgya la sogs pa thams cad su yang rung ba la smras na khyod nyams par gyur ta re/ de bas na thams cad su la yang ma smra zhig de ltar thun mong gi dbang drug gis khyed rnams kyi rags pa phung khams skye mched de bzhin nyid dang bcas pa lhar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phra ba dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir byin gyis rlob par byed pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi'i dang po phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba gdab// dbang stegs la bzhag bkra shis bya// rigs lnga'i dbang bskur dam tshig gsum// rnam dag lha mchod sems can don// chos bshad lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang*// gzengs bstod rtogs bskyed bum dbang ngo*// zhes pa ltar las dang po phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas nas stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams gong du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du da ltar bskyed ma thag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi snying ga'i sa bon las bskur byed de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa nam mkha' gang bar sprul la/ de dag gis kyang mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ brtan g.yo kun khyab sogs sam phun sum tshogs pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ slar yang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dngos gzhi'i tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa rnams brjod cing bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams rim gyis byin te dbang bskur ro// de nas dam tshig gsum rim gyis sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje bshad ma thag pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin can re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas su byin te/ 'di de sogs nas hi hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje gsor te snying gar 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod pa zhu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs nas bdag ces gsungs te de'i don ni/ rdo rje 'dis ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ khyed rnams kyi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de ltar na dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yon du byin te/

'di de sangs rgyas nas rgyal ba bzhed/ ces pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i dril bu de nyid dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod par zhu/ srid pa ngo bo sogs nas byed pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni dril bu 'dis ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig gi slad du/ shes rab bcu drug sogs nas dbang du 'dod/ ces brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma de nyid la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje che dang sogs nas/ bsdu ba nyid du gyis zhes brjod de/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par brjod pa ni/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ shes rab ma lo grangs bcu drug lon pa lta bu de dang phan tshun nu ma la sogs pas reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba la brten nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab par gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ srid pa'i sogs nas brtan phyir ro// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig thams cad la mchod par gyis shig 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da'o// de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'og tu mchod pa rgyas pa'i mchod pa ma byung gi bar du phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin de nyid las ma g.yos par mdzod/

de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa spyi bor bzhag mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang*/ glu dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ gtso bo'i sngags kyi mjug tu badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsha hūm̐ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du lha so so'i sngags la'ang de nyid btags pas chu dbang bskur la/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams/ de nyid la bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par byas te/ de nyid la mnga' dbul gyi tshul du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa rgyas pas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na khyed la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur bas sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma zhes su gsungs sogs nas/ bgegs ni mthar byed ces byar bshad// ces pa ste/ de'i don ni/ sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ sems la phung khams skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ de'ang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rnam dag bstan nas/ rnam dag rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba rnams rim pa bzhin du bsgrub dgos pa las/

thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya rnams mdzad par zhu/ deng nas brtsams te zhes sogs nas/ bsgos/ gaḥzhes pa ste/ de'ang*/ deng phyin chad lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa la sogs pa spyod lam ci byed pa thams cad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan ma yin par lha mchod pa'i bsam pas zin par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ mig thur ram rdo rje la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta nas swā hā zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin gyi mig thur ram/ yang na rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bskyed pas khyed rnams kyi mig gi thad kar byugs pas ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar mig mkhan nas hrīḥpraṃ zhes pas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas nas/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar nges pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/ chos rnams sogs nas sras su skye zhes pas me long dang po'i rjes gnang byin nas/ de ltar kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las du mar snang yang dril bu'i sgra khog pa dang lce dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba gsum gang las byung dpyad na mi rnyed pas rang bzhin gyis stong pa ltar chos nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can du shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du dbyangs tha ma ste aḥtsheg drag can las skyes pa'i dril bu byin te/ thams cad nam mkha'i sogs nas mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ zhes pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/

gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang gral na nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas byos shig ces pas hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu byin te/ thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang nas phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis te drug tu 'phangs pas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom par mos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o zhes gsungs shig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab de'ang thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab ltar don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa tsam ma yin gyi/ dbang gi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu myong yang rang bzhin med pa rang gi snying la zhugs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du me long rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas shes par gyis shig ces pa rnams ni sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang yin no// chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ zhes pas zhabs kyi 'og tu 'khor lo byin te/ sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'dren lugs ji ltar byed na/ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas phyag g.yas su dung byin te/ dung bus la sems can 'khor du sdus shig ces pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar na/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas phyag g.yon par dril bu byin te/ chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na a zhes pas lag ngar gyi steng du rgyud kyi glegs bam byin te/ chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ de ltar nges pa'i sgo nas 'khor lo bskor ba dang dung 'bud pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba dang glegs bam klog pa'i tshul mdzod cig deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa sogs nas srung ba mdzad/

ces pa'i spyir btang chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang byin nas/ chos bshad pa de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa ston dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ ji lta ji ltar sogs nas/ nye bar sbyor zhes dang*/ khyed rang rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du rim par 'phos nas phyag rgya rnams kyi lad mo mdzod/ 'jig rten kun la zhes pa nas/ de ltar gyis zhes pa ste/ de'ang thabs kyi bye brag ji lta bus tshul ji ltar 'dul bar 'gyur ba legs par rtogs nas/ thabs de lta bu dang tshul de ltar sems can gyi don bya dgos pas/ thabs gtsang ba ni dag pa ste// dug lnga gang dang gang 'brel ba// de dang rjes su mthun par bstan nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sbyar bar gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i rnam pas ston srid pas/ 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur nas lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags bag phab pa'i rna ba ltar bzung zhing*/ g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu dang bcas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te khyed rnams rang rang gi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes dkyil 'khor pa dang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mos pa mdzod/ skye dang rga dang sogs nas mthu yin no// zhes pa'i sgo nas lung bstan pas de ltar du 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba bskyed mdzod/ de'i rjes su dbugs dbyung ba la gnyis las/ dang po 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa zhes sogs nas/ ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams btsud cing mthong ba la brten nas deng phyin chad sdig pa dang sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol te/

legs par gnas pa bde ba chen po'i theg pa 'dir tshud pas na/ phyin chad srid pa'i sdug bsngal skye ba dang 'chi ba med pas bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing mi 'chi bas cis kyang 'jigs pa med pas smin grol gyi lam 'di la dga' bar gyis shig de ltar byas na srid pa shin tu dag pa sku bzhi'i 'byor ba thob ste/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin no zhes pa'i tha tshig go /lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dam tshig sdom pa grub pa zhes sogs nas phyin par gyur zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa grub pa 'di dag rtag tu bsrung dgos te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mthun par gsungs pa'i bka' mi bslu ba yin pa'i phyir ro// des na deng phyin chad nas spang bya spang ba'i dbang du byas nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ bsten bya bsten pa'i dbang du byas te/ phyi bya spyod nang rnal 'byor gsang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa gsum dang*/ nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi byang chub sems rnams mi spong zhing*/ rgyud dang man ngag ston par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la kun nas mnar sems pa'i sgo nas brnyas par mi bya ba dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la sdang zhing tho btsams pa'i gdug pa can gnas skabs su tshar gcad cing mthar yongs su mi 'dor bar rjes su gzung ba dang*/ srog chags mi gsod pa dang*/ shes rab yongs su mi spong ba dang*/ slob dpon mi smad pa rnams la shin tu bslab par bstan/ sems brtan pa thob pas/ dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol// zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis mi bya ba 'ga' yang med pa rnams bstan te/ ji ltar bstan pa de dag ngo shes par byas nas gang zag so so'i sa mtshams dang bstun pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin bya ba dang*/

nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs la brtson par gyis shig ces bsgo ba ste/ dbang thob nas dam tshig la gnas pa ni bde ba mi zad pa ster ba po yin pa dang*/ lam gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir gus pas bsten dgos te/ des ni 'gro ba'i nang nas myur bar rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rtag pa dam par phyin par gyur ces pa'o// de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du sogs rtogs bskyed bya'o// sdom ni/ gsang dbang maṇ+ḍal gsol ba btab// gdong bcings dmigs pa mig ras bsal// rtogs bskyed shes rab ye shes la// maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab mig ras bcings// phyag rgya gtad sogs gdong bcings bsam// rtogs bskyed bzhi pa yon gsol gdab// gdong bcings ngo sprad mig ras bsal// rtogs bskyed spro bskyed rjes gsum mo// zhes pa ltar las thog mar gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya zhig kyang slob dpon la phul bar mos pa byas te/ bstod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ stong pa'i snying po zhes sogs nas mdzod/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad slob dpon gyi lus dang phyag rgya'i bha ga gnyis ka'i byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rang rnam par snang mdzad sogs nas dkar ba khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar sogs nas bskur ro// zhes pas bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ 'di ni de nyid sogs nas yang dag myong*/ zhes gsungs pa'i don dran bzhin pas bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te myang bar zhu/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin pa sogs nas skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/

dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na slob dpon gyis lus dang sogs rtogs bskyed bya/ dbang gsum pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan zhi ba sogs nas skyobs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du mig ras gong bzhin 'ching*/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dpon slob gnyis ka skad cig gis 'od dpag med du gyur par mos nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba lang tsho dar la bab pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa cig sprul te de'i lag pa khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yon par gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lha mo mthar byed sogs nas mchod par gyis zhes pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i phyag rgya des khyed rnams la gsang ba'i kun tu spyod pa dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ bshang gci sogs nas tam/ zhes dris pa las/ de ltar spro'o zhes lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bshang gci sogs nas to/ zhes lan btab/ de nas khyed rnams 'od dpag med dang phyag rgya gos dkar mor gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te sogs nas mtshan pa/ khyed rnams kyi gsang gnas sogs nas ṣ+wa me zhes pas mkha' gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te sku gsum lam byed 'du shes gsum dran par byas la/ phyag rgya de gcer bur phyung nas rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma bltar gzhug cing*/ rmad byung sogs nas 'jog pa yin/ zhes brjod cing rang dang lhan cig gnas nas thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba dang*/

sgra la mnyan pa dang*/ dri la bsnams pa dang*/ ma mchus sbrang rtsi myang ba dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ tsum+ba la sogs pa chos drug nyams su myong bas bde ba de dang mi rtog par gyur pa dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba mchog tu dga' ba'i ye shes/ phan tshun brud pa la sogs pa dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung gi rtsa gnas rnams nas gnyis ka'i thig le dkar dmar babs pa/ de nyid rlung gis 'dren pa'i stobs kyis bzung bas bde ba la mi rtog pas brgyan par gyur pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin la/ de nyid ni dkyil 'khor dang lha dang phyag rgya dang de kho na'i dbang dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa dang*// stobs rnams dang ni dbang rnams dang*// sa bcu po ni la gnas pa// rdo rje'i mtshan mar de 'gyur ro// rdo rje bcing ba'i sbyor ba yis// rdo rje mchod pa yang dag brtsam// rdo rje sems ni nges phyung nas// rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya// mnyam par 'byung ba'i cho ga yis// ting 'dzin las skyes sbyin sreg ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar bde ba dang mi rtog pa'i ngang la sems cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes dbang gsum pa'i bshad pa gzhung gis dngos bstan 'di tsam gyis 'thus la/ yang spro na kye rdor ltar phyi go rim la ltos pa dang nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba rnams bshad la/ de rjes su/ de nyid ni dkyil 'khor dang lha dang phyag rgya dang de kho na'i dbang dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ pha rol phyin bcu sogs tshigs bcad sngar bzhin brjod la/ slar yang mas brtan gyi dga' ba sogs kye rdor ltar brjod pas kyang shin tu legs pa zhig 'byung ngo*// de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar mig ras 'grol ba zhu/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems sogs rtogs bskyed bya'o// dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ da ni sangs rgyas sogs nas gzhag par bgyi/ zhes gsol ba btab nas sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas ngo sprod rgyas pa ni dkyus ltar brjod pa yin mod/ 'dir de las cung zad bsdus te brjod na 'dir dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad par bya ste/ de'ang rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab byed dang por/ dbang chog 'dis sbyin par bya ste/ slob ma'i lhag par mos pa dang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rigs pas/ lhag par mos pa'i yid kyis shes par byas nas/ tshig dbang rin po che sbyin par bya ste/ gang thob dbang rab mchog ni rigs kyi bdag pos bzung ba rnyed par dka' zhing mtshungs pa med pas bsdams// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi dpal dag blang bar byas pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur pa// bka' yis gnang ba rnyed nas 'jig rten gsum gyi dgra bo las rgyal rtsom pa'i go cha bgos pa'i blos// byang chub dag la 'god pa'i sems rgyas 'dir ni de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis dri ma med par spyod// ces gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad pa la gsum gyis dang po dbang bzhi pa bstan pa'i yul ni/ slob ma bla ma dang shes rab ye shes kyi nyams myong la lhag par mos pa dang*/ zab mo stong pa nyid dang*/ thabs rgya che ba'i rigs pas rim pa gnyis la lhag par mos pa'i slob ma la sbyin par bya'i gzhan la ni ma yin te/ bla ma la mos pa med na bla ma'i tshig la nges pa mi skye/ dbang gi nyams myong la mos pa med na pha rol tu phyin pa'i thos bsam byas pa dang khyad par med par 'gyur/ spros bral la mos pa med na 'dod chags dang khyad par med de mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems mi skye/

thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa med na gzhan 'dzin pa'i mthu med pas nyan thos rang rgyal dang khyad par med par 'gyur bas na de dag la mi sbyin no// des na mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang snga ma rnams thob pa'i slob ma la dbang bzhi pa sbyin par gsungs la/ de'ang tshig nyid kyi dbang rin po che sbyin par bya ste/ zab cing rgya che la mos na// tshig gi rin chen bskur ba bya// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa de la bstan bya'i dbang bzhi pa skye ba'i rgyu ni/ a bha yas/ de'i rjes la tshig kho nas dbang bzhi pa sbyin par bya'o// shes rab ye shes de nyid myu gur gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rab mchog rigs kyi bdag po'i kha dang rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor rlung 'dren pa'i sgo nas thig le bzung bas gsum pa'i nyams myong man ngag med pa rnams kyis rnyed par dka' zhing*/ dbab pa dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ dgram pa la sogs pa mtshungs pa med pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas bde ba'i rten khams byang chub kyi sems nyid pha rol tu 'phos pa med par rang gi lus la bsdams pa las skyes pa'i ye shes ni dngos kyi rgyu yin/ bum pa la sogs pa dbang gzhan ni brgyud pa'i rgyu yin la de'i rgyu gsang dbang de'i rgyu ni bum pa'i dbang yin te/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ bzhi pa ngo sprod pa'i dang po ris su bri ba ni/ bum pa ser po dang*/ rdo rje dmar po dang*/ chos 'byung dkar po dang*/ pad+ma'i sdong bu bdun la sogs pa rnams bum dbang sogs rim par mtshon byed du bri bar gsungs pa'i don yang rgyu snga ma la brten nas 'bras bu phyi ma 'di dag skye/ zhes bya ba'i don yin no// dbang bzhi pa dngos ni/ de ltar rgyu dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong la brten nas 'bras bu gang skye zhe na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ de'i zhing gi dpal ni de skyed byed chos sku ste yan lag bdun ldan gyi 'bras bu thob ste/

de gang zhe na/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun po nyid dang ldan pa'i bsgrub bya 'di// bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgom blo can rnams kyang bsngags// zhes te/ de la longs spyod rdzogs pa ni mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku ste/ 'di smos pas chos sku dang sprul sku yang shugs kyis bstan te sku gsum tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro// kha sbyar ni rang gi lha mo dang sbyar ba ste kha sbyar spangs pa'i longs sku tsam zhig ni phar phyin theg par yang bshad la/ de las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir dang*/ skye bo 'dod chags can rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyal bas kha sbyor bstan to// bde chen ni sgyu ma mkhan gyi skyes bus sprul pa'i skyes pa dang bud med kha sbyar ba ltar ma yin par/ lus kyi bde ba nyams su myong bas lus bde ba dang*/ sems las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba ni yid bde ba yin la/ chen po ni rgya che ba dang*/ zag pa med pa dang*/ gya nom pa dang*/ 'khor ba ji srid par gnas pas na chen po'o// rang bzhin med pa ni bsgrub bya'i sangs rgyas nyid kyang rang bzhin med pa ste/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gzhan zhig yod na'ang*/ de'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes pa ltar rang bzhin med pa ste/ de'ang rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid yin gyi/ ri bong gi rwa lta bu'i stong pa nyid du ni mi gzung ngo*// snying rjes yongs gang ni/ ji ltar lus kyi rnam pa med par sems can gyi don mi 'grub pa ltar/ snying rje chen po med par sems can gyi don bsgrub par mi nus pas/ snying rje'ang gsum las/

'dir ni dmigs med kyi snying rje yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar rnam par mi rtog bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin la/ rgyun mi chad pa ni longs sku sngar bshad pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i rgyun nyid du rab tu 'jug pas srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir rgyun mi chad pa nyid yin gyi/ skabs kha cig tu 'jug pa dang ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bar chad dang ldan pa ni ma yin no// 'gog pa med pa ni/ longs sku de dus re zhig bzhugs nas mi brtan pa ma yin gyi 'khor ba ji srid rgyun mi chad par gyur te snying rjes gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu 'di nyid ni ngag dbang grags pa bdag 'dod cing der ma zad mkhas pa gzhan rnams kyang 'dod do zhes bya ba'i don to// gal te sngags kyi 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan nyid dbang bzhi par 'chad pa ci zhe na/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ de ltar sgra don ldan nyid phyir// yang gi sgra don ldan phyir dang*// de bzhin sgra don skyes nyid phyir// bzhi pa de bzhin nyid bdag 'dod// ces dang*/ de bzhin du gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ rgyud 'di nyid la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po rnams su/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yang*// zhes dbang gsum pa'i dus su lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa dang bde ba chen po yod pa la sogs pa dper byas nas des mtshon te bzhi pa bstan pa'i tshig de la/ de ltar dang*/ de bzhin dang*/ yang zhes pa'i sgra gsum yod pas/ dbang bzhi pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa dang kha sbyor la sogs pa yan lag bdun ldan du grub par bstan to// mdor na 'bras bu'i dus kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la yan lag bdun dang ldan pa de bzhin du lam rnams kyang yan lag bdun cha mthun gyi tshul du yod pas zab mo'i dbang bzhi pa yang yan lag bdun ldan du ngo sprad dgos kyi/

stong pa kho na dang*/ bde ba 'ba' zhig dang*/ sems kyi gnas cha tsam la bzhi par ngo mi sprod de/ mkhas grub chen po a bha yā ka ras/ byang chub kyi sems rab tu bsgoms pas rab tu 'phel bzhin pa sgrib pa med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin can dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// don de nyid rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal brtag pa gnyis par yang gsungs te/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po'i mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes yan lag bdun ldan du gsungs te/ de'ang zab cing rtogs par dka' bas na ches phra ba ste/ 'dis longs sku'i yan lag bstan/ mi phyed pas na rdo rje ste/ 'dis kha sbyor gyi yan lag bstan/ thams cad 'byung bas na snying po ste 'dis 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag bstan/ gang du yang ma grub pas na nam mkha' ste/ 'dis rgyun mi chad pa'i yan lag bstan/ mi rtog pas na rdul bral te/ 'dis snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag bstan/ mya ngan las 'das pas na mtha' ster ba ste/ 'dis bde ba chen po'i yan lag bstan/ rtog pa zhi bas na zhi ba ste/ 'dis rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag bstan/ 'jig rten na phas bu bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa khyod kyis kyang rig ma la brten nas/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes cung zad cig rgyud la skyes pa de'i rgyun bskyangs pa la rag las pas/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// de ltar bskyangs pas/ mthar sgrib pa thams cad zad pa'i dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa dbang bzhi pa nyid thob bo zhes bya ba'i don yin no// de dag gi don nyams su blangs pa las sku gsum gyi nyams skye'o// de'ang ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur ba ste ye shes de mngon du byas pa ni de kho na nyid mthong ba nyid yin te khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i ched du khyed rang rnams lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas zhes sogs nas/

'dzin med du lhod kyis glod de mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes pa'i bar kye rdo rje'i dbang chu ltar brjod/ gsum pa dbang thob nas nyams su blang bar gdams pa ni/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa'i man ngag gis bka'i gnang ba rnyed nas da ni dbang dang man ngag thob pa ste snyam pa'i rlom sems bskyed nas bag med par 'dug par bya ba ma yin gyi/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dgra bo nyon mongs pa dang de'i rgyu rnam rtog las rgyal te mtshan ma dang rnam rtog med par bya'o snyam pa brtson pa'i go bgos pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i blo ste shes rab dang*/ sems can thams cad byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems rab tu rgyas pa'i snying rje'i sgo nas sems can gzhan gyi don la 'dir ni chags par bya'o// de ltar gzhan don byed kyang de kho nyid thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni sems can du zhen pa'i dri ma med par dpyod cing*/ thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa la 'bad dgos so// de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol ba zhu/ de ltar na sogs rtog bskyed bya/ de nas mjug gi bya ba la/ de ltar dbang rdzogs par thob pas khyed rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshig 'di dag gi rjes zlos gsung ba zhu/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas sogs nas ma mchis zhes pas spro ba bskyed nas/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba yongs su grub pas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing*/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig thams cad la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs nas bgyi zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la drin lan du 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsams sogs nas spyad du gsol zhes pas de rnams kyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyag chen po dpal bir+wa pa'i zhal snga nas bkral zhing rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bka' babs pa'i dpal sam+pu ṭa rdo rje dbyings lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs par gsan pas lam la 'bad pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod la rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// smras pa/ gsang rgyud du ma'i gsal byed kha sbyor gyi// rgyud chen dri med kyis bstan dkyil 'khor du// smin byed cho ga'i mtshams sbyor smra ba yi// rigs su skyes pa 'di ko bla ma'i drin// spyi bshad ma dros klu dbang gnas las blangs// khyad par rnam gsal gnyis 'thung mgrin par brgyud// legs byung dbang gi mtshams sbyor gaṅgā'i klung*// skal bzang 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyang phyir rgyu// 'di bgyis dge ba kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ri// rgyu skar bdag po sa dga'i me tog ltar// rnam par dkar ba gang des sems can kun// 'bras bu'i theg par smin cing grol gyur cig /ces pa dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni gsang chen rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin dbang phun tshogs rgya mtsho pa'i bka' drin las/ 'di'i dbang bskur mnos pa'i tshe/ ma 'ongs pa'i don gnyer rnams la phan pa'i phyir dbang gi mtshams sbyor gzung bde bar bris shig ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ nye char chos kyi rje bla ma bkra shis dpal bzang pa'i gsung gis kyang bskur ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i 'dun pa ma bor tsam gyi chos smra ba tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar rab byung 'dod pa'i rnam byung lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i zla skyes mdza' lha 'jom pa'i tshes dge bar grub par bgyis pa a n+yār+tha bistā ra bha wa tu//
